name: benchmark-homedepot
description: benchmark-homedepot contains Home Depot product data intended to evaluate models on tasks such as product categorization, attribute extraction, and query-to-product matching in an e-commerce setting. It tests a model's ability to understand product descriptions, extract structured attributes, and assign correct product categories. The dataset is suited for applied retail NLP experiments focused on classification and information extraction.
reputation: A small, user-contributed e-commerce dataset with limited adoption outside reproductions and domain-specific experiments.
